}}

{{recipe}}

Folding in unsweetened [[Cookbook:Whipped Cream|whipped cream]] makes this [[Cookbook:Macaroni and Cheese|mac 'n cheese]] casserole light and airy.

== Ingredients ==
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Mascarpone Cheese|mascarpone cheese]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 2 cups [[Cookbook:Heavy Cream|heavy cream]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] cooked macaroni [[Cookbook:Pasta|pasta]]
* 1 cup heavy whipping cream, [[Cookbook:Whipping|whipped]] to soft peaks

== Procedure ==
#Melt butter in a large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] over medium heat. [[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]] in flour and cook until light blond color is achieved.
#Add remaining ingredients except for macaroni and whipped cream. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] until reduced by half. Remove from heat and gently fold in cream.
#Place macaroni in the bottom of a 9x13-inch square [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]]. Pour cheese mixture over and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] in a 350°F [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] for 25 minutes, or until bubbly on top and puffed up. Remove and serve.
